source_title: Hubris, Holy War, and the Petrodollar Trap
summary: This March 11 Jimmy Dore follow-up is a dense Iran-war forecast audit: it joins imperial hubris, war-of-destruction logic, Hormuz/cheap-energy collapse, petrodollar dependence, eschatological war sequencing, hidden-power method, and survival as human-heart/free-will pressure.

existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Human Heart page already uses this source to show relation as survival when money and private protection stop carrying the world.

existing_lens_links.rationale: This directly matches the Chokepoint Empire / No-Exit War anchor, but the episode link should wait for a Strategy-family provenance pass because the read's current linked marks already serve Human Heart and Secret Society.

existing_lens_links.rationale: The existing cheap-energy-platform anchor owns the material condition: Gulf/Hormuz fragility turns modern industrial civilization back into food, water, labor, and route access.

existing_lens_links.rationale: This source belongs with the Power As Alchemy dollar-protection loop only where the monetary sign, foreign dollar demand, and petrodollar protection are the active mechanism.

new_lens_seeds.title: Energy Reversal As De-Industrialization
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: When cheap oil stops being reliable, modern society does not merely become poorer; the industrial arrangement reverses into food, fertilizer, transport, rural production, military route protection, and mercantilist self-sufficiency.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism could connect Iran/Hormuz sources, Gulf fragility, Japan/Korea import exposure, data-center/AI energy limits, ruralization, and civilizational contraction without reducing them to a generic energy topic.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a seed, not a public page: Chokepoint Empire currently owns most of this material. Promote only if cross-source comparison shows a broader civilizational energy-reversal mechanism that cannot fit inside the Strategy child page.

chronology_notes.note: This 2026-03-11 interview follows the March 9 Glenn Diesen no-exit source and gives a public Jimmy Dore prediction-audit version of the same Iran-war cluster: earlier Trump/Iran/U.S.-loss forecast, Iraq-2003 hubris, Hormuz loss condition, and first-term Trump Middle East moves as preconditions.

The source explicitly contrasts the current war with the 2003 Iraq War: even the Iraq regime-change campaign passed through public, constitutional, diplomatic, and evidentiary ritual, while this war appears to Jiang as a script being executed without political persuasion.

Jiang gives a five-to-ten-year post-war trend sequence: de-industrialization from cheap-oil loss, remilitarization to protect routes and supply networks, and mercantilist self-sufficiency as global trade conditions break.

The speculative future sequence runs from U.S. ground invasion and national draft to five-to-ten-year failed Iran war, low-intensity U.S. civil war, American retreat to the Western Hemisphere, GCC collapse, Iran recovery, Odessa/Russia opening, European implosion, Turkey partition, and Pax Judaica.

Jiang explicitly labels his hidden-script account as intellectual speculation without concrete evidence, based on extrapolating a perceived ten-year pattern; any canon or ledger work should preserve this epistemic caveat.

canon_candidates.rationale: This caveat should travel with any Secret Society, Eschatology, or forecast-ledger promotion based on this source, because it prevents the lens from converting Jiang's speculative script into settled canon.
